description: Retrieval golden set, v2. The first version scored 100% hit@5 and MRR 1.000 for every strategy including naive dense search, which means it measured nothing: each question shared obvious vocabulary with exactly one document, so BM25 alone won and translation, fusion and reranking had no tie to break. These questions are written against that failure. Each one either (a) uses no significant vocabulary from its source, so lexical matching cannot carry it, (b) has a plausible wrong answer in another document, so ranking has to be right rather than merely non-empty, (c) is asked in German about English content, or (d) targets one section of a long document, so file-level retrieval is not enough. `expected` lists acceptable source files. `expected_sections`, where present, lists acceptable section labels - more than one because the chunker merges short adjacent prose sections and the chunk carries the first heading.
